This topic is part of the AQA GCSE PE specification.

Health, Fitness and Well-being appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Health, Fitness and Well-being in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Health, Fitness and Well-being.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
